double whammy.meaning: Họa vô đơn chí, tổn thất kép.
double whammy.example: Losing his job and wrecking his car on the same day was a real double whammy for John.

down in the dumps.example: Jane's been down in the dumps since she lost her job.

down in the mouth.example: After hearing the bad news, she was really down in the mouth.

down the tube.meaning: Đổ sông đổ biển, thất bại hoàn toàn.
down the tube.example: All the time and effort went down the tube when the project was canceled.

down to the wire.meaning: Tới phút chót, đến phút cuối cùng mới ngã ngũ.
down to the wire.example: The election came down to the wire with results revealed just before midnight.

down to earth.meaning: Thực tế, bình dị, gần gũi, không kiểu cách.
down to earth.example: Despite her massive international fame, she remains remarkably down to earth.
